description: The four nil-carrying results of the Wippy v1 process surface - Event.payload, which answers an optional value, and the optional result, error and reason fields of an Event - are each read twice: unguarded, where the declared nil reaches a consumer that cannot take it, and behind the test that rules it out, which must be silent. Semantics follow runtime/lua/modules/process/types.go, where the event record declares those three fields optional because which one an event carries depends on the kind that raised it.
